items: 将任务与计划排序交互迁移到宿主公开 nxp-* 控件，保持任务编辑和计划列表的排序操作。
签到任务列表改为扁平列表，支持持久化排序和任务名称首字头像。
任务编辑器改用宿主公共弹窗，包含备注、五个平台游戏与凭据设置，以及可排序计划。
签到通知改用宿主全局渠道，可选覆盖 SMTP 收件人；空收件人继承全局设置。
直接使用全新的任务存储格式，不导入 0.3.0 独立任务数据，并删除插件自有通知传输。
新增独立签到任务、固定时间计划、手动执行和运行结果记录。
每个任务使用独立凭据，并可配置独立 Webhook 与 SMTP 通知。
移除绑定用户运行事件、全局设置贡献和用户列表徽章。

en-US.description: Create multi-platform game check-in tasks using host global notifications and local schedules.

items: Migrated task and schedule sorting interactions to the host's public nxp-* controls while preserving reorder operations in task editing and schedule lists.
Changed the task list to a flat, persistently reorderable list with name-initial avatars.
Moved task editing to the host modal with remarks, five-platform game and credential settings, and reorderable schedules.
Switched check-in notifications to host global channels with an optional SMTP recipient override that inherits the global recipient when blank.
Started with a new task store without importing 0.3.0 task data and removed plugin-owned notification transports.
Added independent check-in tasks, fixed-time schedules, manual runs, and run results.
Each task now has independent credentials and Webhook or SMTP notifications.
Removed user-run hooks, global settings contributions, and user-list badges.

description: 创建多平台游戏签到任务，配置本机时区计划、手动执行、运行结果与宿主全局通知。
